verdict.rationale: The integrations directory lists first-party Datadog (create incidents from monitors), Grafana (attach alerts) and Sentry (link errors) integrations. The on-call docs claim over 40 alert sources plus custom HTTP sources and say you configure alerts from your observability tools. However, Prometheus and CloudWatch are never named, and no per-integration setup documentation appears beyond one-line directory blurbs. Missing for 10: explicit Prometheus/Alertmanager integration, explicit CloudWatch integration, documented step-by-step setup guides for each tool, independent corroboration.
